test_cases.description: A cluster of nodes primarily describing database pooling and connection strings.

cluster_members: Postgres driver requires sslmode=disable for local dev

test_cases.description: A cluster of nodes describing JWT token validation and middleware.

cluster_members: Extract Bearer token from Authorization header
Validate JWT signature against public JWKS endpoint
Return 401 Unauthorized if token is expired
Attach user_id to request context in auth middleware
